fixedpoint.criterion: exact stage-one/stage-two byte equality was required before measurement

outputAuthentication.rule: candidate native and JS lanes are compared to each other; the control is compared to its authenticated accepted baseline

note: Unprofiled, same-host, sequentially interleaved clean full-root pairs on the frozen G22 corpus; profiled cost-attribution runs are excluded. Measurements are diagnostic evidence, not a performance acceptance.

commands.environment: env HEAVY_GATE_MEMORY_MIB=8192 HEAVY_GATE_RSS_MIB=8192 HEAVY_GATE_POLL_MS=10 HEAVY_GATE_TIMEOUT_MS=600000 BUN_JSC_forceRAMSize=4294967296

interpretation: All twelve unprofiled serial measurements completed; no sample excluded or pooled with prior screens. JS pipeline is faster in every paired run, native slower in every paired run. RSS and footprint move in opposite directions across runtimes; no universal memory improvement or cross-backend speedup is established. Correctness/consumer qualification remains in progress. No assistant-invented relative-memory rejection threshold is applied.

nativeR12.observation: Hot CheckerRunState returns are already the three-component r0/r1/r2 WL_RETN(3); only StackMore allocates there.

jsR12.observation: Hot continuations materialize CheckerRunState as JS object literals; Pending/Direct also materialize StackMore.

jsG31.observation: The unchanged G30 image eliminates those per-transition RunState object literals, retaining StackMore and guarded calls into chunk_state.

nativeProducer.observation: The native seed is generated by canonical comp.ts compile_book, not the selfhost BIR renderer.

bir.observation: Calls and returns carry a single Atom; no explicit multi-result call/return or parameterized local loop block.

jsScalar.observation: Existing scalar replacement rejects aggregate escape through returns or call arguments.

backendAsymmetry.interpretation: This establishes different representation-level benefits of the source transformation, not a complete causal attribution of the native timing loss. A paired native execution profile is still required to attribute dispatch/frame/machine-code costs. BIR-level interprocedural aggregate transport removal is a proposed next experiment, not implemented or measured here.
